title: Update Rust link wire documentation and signed-frame length regression test
description: rust/lichen-link/src/lib.rs still documents bit 7 as reserved and omits the mandatory 8-byte signer EUI-64 from the wire layout; LinkLayer docs also claim frames lack a sender hint and require O(n) verification although SI now provides indexed lookup. In rust/lichen-link/src/schnorr.rs si_frame_serialises_and_verifies computes signed LENGTH without signer_eui64.len(), so it signs a length different from the serialized wire and never verifies the parsed wire transcript. Update source docs and make the regression test derive/verify the exact serialized LENGTH.
